PhD Position in Political Science: Militarization and Democratic Erosion in Latin America
Faculty of Social and Behavioural Sciences
€3,204 - €4,051
Closes on
06-11-2026
Master's
38 hours
The Department of Political Science is looking for a PhD candidate to work in the “Doctoral Network Democratic Institutions and Violence Network in Europe (DIViNE)” project, funded by the HORIZON MSCA action. The candidate will be supervised by Dr. Abbey Steele (University of Amsterdam) and Dr. Juan Masullo (University of Milan) and join a network of 10 PhD candidates across five universities. At the University of Amsterdam, the PhD candidate will be part of the Amsterdam Institute for Social Science Research (AISSR) programme group Political Institutions and Identities (PII).DIViNE brings together leading European research environments — UvA (Amsterdam), UESSEX (Essex), UMIL (Milan), UC3M (Carlos III de Madrid) and UU (Uppsala) — and partner organizations to combine complementary strengths in quantitative conflict research, behavioral and experimental methods, historical and archival inquiry, institutional and normative theory, and applied policy engagement.

PhD Position 'Why Are the Super-Rich So Tax-Averse?'
Faculty of Social and Behavioural Sciences
€3,204 - €4,051
Closes on
26-10-2026
Master's
38 hours
The super-rich avoid and evade personal taxation a great deal, but why are they so tax-averse? Is it simply what anyone would do, given the opportunity? Or is it their social environment that makes them think avoiding and evading is appropriate? UvA’s Political Science department has two vacancies for PhD candidates to tackle these questions.

PhD Position in Political Science
Faculty of Social and Behavioural Sciences
€3,204 - €4,051
Closes on
11-11-2026
Master's
38 hours
The Department of Political Science is looking for a PhD candidate to work in the “Doctoral Network Democratic Institutions and Violence Network in Europe (DIViNE)” project, funded by the HORIZON MSCA action. The candidate will be supervised by Dr. Ursula Daxecker (University of Amsterdam and Max Planck Institute for Political and Social Science) and Dr. Hanne Fjelde (University of Uppsala) and join a network of 10 PhD candidates across five universities. At the University of Amsterdam, the PhD candidate will be part of the Amsterdam Institute for Social Science Research (AISSR) programme group Political Institutions and Identities (PII).DIViNE brings together leading European research environments — UvA (Amsterdam), UESSEX (Essex), UMIL (Milan), UC3M (Carlos III de Madrid) and UU (Uppsala) — and partner organizations – including the new Max Planck Institute for Political and Social Science — to combine complementary strengths in quantitative conflict research, behavioral and experimental methods, historical and archival inquiry, institutional and normative theory, and applied policy engagement.

PhD Position: Groundwater Care and the Politics of Transformation (India)
Faculty of Social and Behavioural Sciences
€3,204 - €4,051
Closes on
02-11-2026
Master's
38 hours
Do you want to pursue a PhD in political ecology, development studies or environmental humanities? Are you interested in (ground-)water? This PhD project – that examines the practices that individuals and communities in India engage in to care for, protect, rejuvenate and/or recharge the groundwaters they rely on for irrigating their crops – might be of interest to you.
